trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no separate task for the Platinum: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically with the last of them. Work the roadmap in this guide in order — story first, then side strands, activities, collectibles and crime — and treat this trophy as the finish line, not a job of its own. KeenGamer's platinum roadmap gives the same order of work.
